in_arabic.name: Poonah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Poonah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'barq', which means lightning and 'oonah', meaning blessing or fortune. The name Poonah represents a woman who is blessed with lightning-fast intellect and graceful beauty.
